Muslim Neurosurgeon talks Neuroplasticity, Islam & Our Brain | Dr Athar N Malik | AHI #4

Al Hakam INSPIRE Podcast
May 12 2022 • 47 mins
Our guest is Dr Athar N Malik MD/PhD, Neurosurgery Chief Resident at Massachusetts General Hospital & Harvard Neuroscience Researcher in Neurobiology. He has a special interest in Brain Circuits, Functional & Restorative Neurosurgery. He is also a member of Muslim Scientists, USA.
We speak about how Our Brain Functions, Neuroplasticity and Neural circuits. We discuss how Islam & religion may help humans to reach their potential, and the future of research between Science & Our Spirituality.
